method: All numeric-bearing added lines in the rename-aware integration diff reviewed with consumer context, including defaults, examples and tests; final Qt/core/QML patches reviewed separately after the frozen audit. Lexical candidates include type/identifier/comment matches and are not a literal count. Mixed inline-test/production partitions were reviewed in context. This record does not claim every line of every changed file was manually reviewed.

reviewers.QML/JS presentation: isolated upstream_ui audit and root patch review
reviewers.Rust APIs, bindings and tooling: isolated qa_audit review and root patch review

decisions: Share constants only for identical semantics, including physical-bin admission, stage text guards and existing query/policy domains.
Name independent execution, display, coordinate and temporal limits separately even when equal.
Name local editor hints and example presets without widening Rust validation.
Retain explained mathematical identities, representation/wire anchors, layout pixel choices and independent literal numerical test vectors.
Keep actual-capacity Rust accounting, logical QML presentation limits and separate finite execution limits unchanged.

Compile four private API-only policies only with high-level-api; analysis-only builds retain their independent feature contract. The final rebuilt wheel has byte-identical archive members to the full-native test artifact.
additional_patch_review: Root reviewed the required control-reference runner wiring and its existing consumer-derived regression check; no scientific values or public operations changed.
